newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi, Visco, Treu meet ahead of DPEF.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi, Visco, Treu meet ahead of DPEF.

text.p: Italy's Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi, Finance Minister Vincenzo Visco and Labour Minister Tiziano Treu met on Wednesday for talks on the government's upcoming document of three-year economic targets.
The meeting lasted an hour and a half, political sources said. Treasury undersecretary Enrico Micheli and Deputy Prime Minister also attended the meeting.
The centre-left cabinet is due to approve the plan, known as the DPEF, at a meeting on Friday. The plan will also contain the government's deficit-cutting plans in 1998.

Parliamentary party leaders from the ruling centre-left alliance, including the hard-left Communist Refoundation party whose support secures Prime Minister Romano Prodi's parliamentary majority, were due to meet on Thursday morning.
The government was due to meet union and employers leaders on Thursday afternoon for talks on the DPEF.
